stem.text: Identical springs are joined in four arrangements.
Which arrangement has the same spring constant as a single spring?

A.alt: Spring hanging from a fixed support, with a load box at its lower end.

B.alt: Two springs side by side hanging from a fixed support, both joined to a single load box below.

C.alt: Two columns side by side hanging from a fixed support, each made of two springs joined end to end, both columns joined to a single load box below.

D.alt: Two springs side by side hanging from a fixed support, joined to a horizontal bar, with a third spring below the bar and a load box at its lower end.
